$comment: Kids check-in streaks and achievements. One weekly streak type counts every check-in under Rock's Weekly Service Check-in template, and seven achievement types read it. The loader fills in the streaks and attempts Rock would have computed at each check-in. Component is 'consecutive' (Rock's Streaks: Consecutive) or 'accumulative' (Streaks: Accumulative). A null maxAccomplishmentsAllowed means unlimited. An achievement's prerequisite must come before it in the list. Icons are Font Awesome 5 classes that Rock bundles.
